svg.title: The section recovers its coordinate formula. For a ground-coordinate projection QG, composition gives (QGRX)∗bηX = (QG)∗(νX ⊗γX). Thus equal local marginals and fiberwise integrands give the same locality identity after realization. All address and tree-choice labels are retained, so the finite independent average and the global-to-local ticket bijection commute with these integral equalities. The summable integral-norm majorant then permits the same molecule series to be integrated on either side. No tree covariance is replaced during this recovery.
